europe_now.title: Berlin and Vienna attack plot uncovered
europe_now.summary: An indictment reveals that Hamas planned attacks targeting Berlin and Vienna around the anniversary of October 7. Authorities have uncovered the operational details through recent legal filings.

sources.headline: Hamas planned Berlin-Vienna attacks for Oct. 7 anniversary, indictment shows

europe_now.title: Energy cost resistance from Central European states
europe_now.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk announced that Poland and other V4 nations will block European Union measures that lead to increased energy costs. The coalition aims to protect regional consumers from burdensome pricing policies.

sources.headline: Poland and other V4 countries will block EU measures that raise energy costs, warns Tusk

top_stories.title: Germany's financial strategy for Ukraine
top_stories.summary: Germany has introduced a proposal for a new financial loan directed at supporting Ukraine. The funding mechanism is designed to be secured by utilizing frozen Russian assets.

sources.headline: Germany floats new Ukraine loan backed by frozen Russian assets

top_stories.title: Political shifts and diplomatic changes in Hungary
top_stories.summary: Hungary's government under Magyar has expelled ten Russian diplomats from the country. Additionally, authorities have moved to dismantle previous county-level political structures associated with Fidesz.

sources.headline: Magyar’s Hungary expels 10 Russian diplomats and dismantles Fidesz’s county fiefdoms (Day 122 of the Tisza government)
